name: Multitasking
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of focused diligence and single-minded devotion rather than divided attention. Joshua 1:8 encourages constant meditation on God's law to achieve success, while Proverbs 21:5 contrasts the fruitful plans of the diligent with the failure of the hasty. Ecclesiastes 4:6 highlights the value of quiet contentment over the stress of overburdened efforts, and Matthew 6:24 warns that one cannot truly serve two masters, underscoring the necessity of undivided loyalty. Together, these verses teach that multitasking, especially in spiritual matters, can hinder wisdom, prosperity, and faithful service to God.
